old_tlc_regression: one v8 unified-runner loop (243.13s) with unchanged workload recipes/scripts; v7 TLC run retained as historical evidence
new_xlsx_flow: enhance final output via generic atomic helper -> original recalc.py in place (LibreOffice save) -> spreadsheet-semantic-v3 verification; no assemble_output/inject_caches/patch in the formal recipes
runner_self_preparation: direct runner and entry/suite share the same registry resolution, frozen-binding validation, source context / Skill links / Python environment preparation, and timing hooks
runner_interpreter_unification: direct runner re-execs under the requested interpreter (venv 3.12.3 or system 3.11.6) before the loop, so the runner and recipe tools always use one consistent Python; wrong/missing interpreter is rejected
defined_names_protection: global and worksheet-local names are tracked by (name, scope); reference meaning must be preserved (A1->A2, nonexistent targets, scope moves, indirect missing references and cycles are rejected or handled); only supported serialization differences are diagnostics
formula_normalization: sheet/workbook identifiers and double-quoted string literals are tokenized; meaningful whitespace, punctuation, escaped single quotes and the intersection operator are preserved; bounded serialization equivalences only
classification: canonicalized deterministic replay derived from successful Agent executions; no new Agent trajectory
historical_aliases: opm_v2/tlc_v2 route to the derived-v1 historical engine and parent recipes; they run last, --timed is rejected up front, and they are not canonicalized workloads
